about: Word-for-word passages on reporting to Social Security, used by the monthly report. Kept apart from authorities.json so the two reviewers' rulebooks do not change.

passages.text: Unless the circumstances in § 416.709(a) and (c) apply, you must report to us any increase or decrease in your income
You must report to us any resources you receive or part with

You should report to us as soon as an event listed in § 416.708 happens. If you do not report within 10 days after the close of the month in which the event happens, your report will be late. We may impose a penalty deduction from your benefits for a late report (see §§ 416.722 through 416.732).
(1) $25 for a report overdue in the first penalty period; (2) $50 for a report overdue in the second penalty period; and (3) $100 for a report overdue in the third (or any following) penalty period.
Change in help with living expenses from friends or relatives.
Report any changes that may affect your SSI as soon as possible and no later than 10 days after the end of the month in which the change occurred.

passages.cite: SSA, Spotlight on Rights and Responsibilities
passages.text: Please visit or write any Social Security office, or call our toll-free number at 1-800-772-1213.
